'''Ithes Olok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologist]] present at the [[Mensix Mining Facility/Legends|Mensix Mining Facility]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

Olok was on Mustafar that year, searching for the artifacts of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Chu-Gon Dar]], namely his [[Chu-Gon Dar cube|cube]], which was said to be infused with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and have special powers of combination to it. Olok located the cube, but was upset to find that it did not work as expected. He hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] visiting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to investigate some local [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] ruins. He believed that the ruins held the information needed to activate the cube. The spacer traveled to the ruins and found several ancient tablets detailing the cube. After returning the tablets to Olok, he was able to activate the cube, and as a reward, he gave it to the spacer, on the condition that he would test it out for him by attempting to combine the various "glowing" items he found on Mustafar.

==Behind the scenes==
Ithes Olok was a non-playable character in the massively multiplayer online roleplaying game [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']] prior to the game's closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. He, along with the planet Mustafar, were added to the game in [[November]] of [[2005]] in the expansion pack ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''.

The "glowing" items mentioned were various items that the player could loot on Mustafar, ranging from a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to a patch of hair, that were apparently infused with the Force, although the player was not required to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] to sense their Force signature. The player could use the cube to combine these items into various weapons, schematics, and decorations for the player's house.
